Container.Name: bawksync
Container.Overview:
End-to-end encrypted sync server for bawkterm, an SSH, SFTP and Remote Desktop client. It stores only data your devices encrypted, so it cannot read your hosts, passwords or keys.
First start: leave Token empty and one is created for you. It is printed once in the log and saved in the data folder as "tokens". To show it again, open the container's Console and run: bawksync tokens
In bawkterm, connect to http://[your Unraid IP]:8787 with that token.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: bawkterm sync ssh sftp rdp terminal termius encrypted self-hosted

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Encrypted database and the tokens file.

Config.Name: Token
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to have a token created on first start. Or paste your own: 32 or more random characters.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the data folder. 99 is nobody on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the data folder. 100 is users on Unraid.
